name: Legacy URL Fixer
description: Scans and repairs legacy REDCap image/file URLs in project configuration.

authors.name: Günther Rezniczek
authors.institution: St. Elisabethgruppe GmbH - Marien Hospital Herne | Klinikum der Ruhr-Universität Bochum

project-settings.name: Allow cross-project e-document URL repairs
project-settings.description: Disabled by default. Enable only for intentional links copied from another project. The URL must still use the configured REDCap host and have an exact valid document hash for the e-document's owning project.

system-settings.name: Force cross-project e-document URL repairs for all projects
system-settings.description: Disabled by default. When enabled, this Control Center setting overrides the project setting and permits verified legacy URLs to reference an e-document owned by another project. The configured REDCap host and exact document hash are still required.
